import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9VGJ4.json",timeout=60).json()
for x in j["uniProtKBCrossReferences"]:
    if x["database"] in ("ESTHER","IntAct","STRING","BioGRID-ORCS","RefSeq","KEGG"):
        print(x["database"], x["id"], [p.get("value") for p in x.get("properties",[])])

def af(a):
    jj=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}",timeout=60).json()[0]
    return requests.get(jj["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
def parse(p):
    at={}
    for l in p.splitlines():
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            ri=int(l[22:26]); an=l[12:16].strip()
            a=at.setdefault(ri,{"resname":l[17:20].strip(),"plddt":float(l[60:66]),"at":{}})
            a["at"][an]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return at
Hm,Qm=parse(af("Q8NFV4")),parse(af("Q9VGJ4"))

anchors=[(132,120),(287,282),(156,144),(64,52),(65,53),(131,119),(134,122),(286,281),(288,283),
         (155,143),(157,145),(63,51),(66,54),(130,118),(135,123),(285,280),(289,284)]
P=np.array([Hm[h]["at"]["CA"] for h,q in anchors]); Q=np.array([Qm[q]["at"]["CA"] for h,q in anchors])
pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc)); R=U@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(U@Vt))])@Vt
rms=np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(P-((Q-qc)@R.T+pc),axis=1)**2).mean())
def X(v): return (v-qc)@R.T+pc
print(f"\nlocal active-site superposition RMSD over {len(anchors)} CA anchors: {rms:.2f} A")

# project onto the best-fitting plane of the human triad for a 2D active-site view
key=np.array([Hm[132]["at"]["OG"],Hm[287]["at"]["NE2"],Hm[156]["at"]["OD1"],Hm[65]["at"]["CA"],Hm[287]["at"]["ND1"]])
ctr=key.mean(0); u_,s_,vt_=np.linalg.svd(key-ctr); e1,e2=vt_[0],vt_[1]
def p2(v): w=v-ctr; return np.array([w@e1,w@e2])

fig,(ax,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,6.2),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,1.25]})
def draw(ax,res,atoms,col,lab,f,ls="-"):
    xy=np.array([p2(f(res["at"][a])) for a in atoms if a in res["at"]])
    ax.plot(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],ls,marker="o",color=col,ms=5,lw=2.2)
    ax.annotate(lab,xy[-1],textcoords="offset points",xytext=(6,5),color=col,fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ident=lambda v:v
draw(ax,Hm[132],["N","CA","CB","OG"],"#1f6fd0","Ser132",ident)
draw(ax,Hm[287],["CA","CB","CG","ND1","CE1","NE2"],"#1f6fd0","His287",ident)
draw(ax,Hm[156],["CA","CB","CG","OD1"],"#1f6fd0","Asp156",ident)
draw(ax,Hm[65],["N","CA","C"],"#1f6fd0","Gly65",ident)
draw(ax,Qm[120],["N","CA","C"],"#d1495b","Gly120",X)
draw(ax,Qm[282],["CA","CB","CG","ND1","CE1","NE2"],"#d1495b","His282",X)
draw(ax,Qm[144],["CA","CB","CG","OD1"],"#d1495b","Asp144",X)
draw(ax,Qm[53],["N","CA","CB","CG","OD1","OD2"],"#d1495b","Asp53",X)
a=p2(Hm[132]["at"]["OG"]); b=p2(X(Qm[53]["at"]["OD1"]))
ax.plot(*zip(a,b),ls=":",color="k",lw=1.5)
ax.annotate("2.65 Å",(a+b)/2,textcoords="offset points",xytext=(4,-12),fontsize=8.5)
c=p2(Hm[287]["at"]["NE2"])
ax.set_xlim(c[0]-9,c[0]+9); ax.set_ylim(c[1]-8,c[1]+8); ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("F  Active-site overlay (projected)\nhuman ABHD11 blue, CG14717 red; local RMSD %.2f Å"%rms,
             fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.plot([],[],color="#1f6fd0",lw=2.5,label="human ABHD11 (active)")
ax.plot([],[],color="#d1495b",lw=2.5,label="Dmel CG14717")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,frameon=False,loc="lower left")

tbl=[["protein","oxyanion HG-loop","nucleophile elbow","catalytic acid*","catalytic His","verdict"],
     ["human ABHD11","H64-G65","GHSMGG (Ser132)","Asp156 (2.72 Å)","His287","active: S132A abolishes\np-nitrophenyl ester hydrolysis"],
     ["yeast IMO32","H81-G82","GHSMGG (Ser152)","Glu176 (2.87 Å)","His319","triad complete"],
     ["Dmel CG2059","H59-G60","GHSMGG (Ser127)","Asp151 (2.68 Å)","His286","triad complete"],
     ["Dmel CG14717","H52-D53","GHGMGG (Gly120)","Asp144 (2.72 Å)","His282","no nucleophile;\nAsp53 fills the oxyanion hole"]]
ax2.axis("off")
t=ax2.table(cellText=tbl[1:],colLabels=tbl[0],loc="center",cellLoc="left")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.8); t.scale(1,2.4)
for (r,cc),cell in t.get_celld().items():
    cell.set_edgecolor("#dddddd")
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#eef1f5"); cell.set_text_props(fontweight="bold")
    if r==4: cell.set_text_props(color="#d1495b",fontweight="bold")
ax2.set_title("G  Catalytic machinery. *acid assigned structurally from AlphaFold\n"
              "(distance = carboxylate O to catalytic His ND1), not from UniProt",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
